title: Nettrace: move parsing to traceRecSession level per packet
description:
traceRecSession contains information and attributes which can be utilized for EXPORTED_PDU

```plaintext
<traceCollecFile>
  <traceRecSession>
    <msg>
      <rawMsg>AAAAA</rawMsg>
    </msg>
  </traceRecSession>
</traceCollecFile>
```

notes.body: I think there may be several `<msg> ... </msg>` in a `<traceRecSession>`, is that handled?
ah, you are correct! Will try to add it
I think this is not needed any more.
